title: CyclingPlan
description: Cardio/cycling training plan for the IronLog app. The plan contains workout templates; each template is a sequence of timed segments executed in order. Segments can be a leaf (warmup/work/recovery/cooldown/steady) or an interval_block that repeats N times over its children. The app guides the user through each segment with a timer, target heart-rate range, and (when an Apple Watch is available) live HR readings. Without HR source the app still runs the timer and assumes the user followed the plan. IMPORTANT: use this schema strictly -- unknown fields are ignored, wrong types cause import failure.

plan_type.description: Plan type. Determines which validator runs on the server.

plan_id.description: Stable plan identifier (slug). Does not change when the plan is renamed. Example: "norwegian-4x4-progression"

plan_version.description: Content version. Increment when updating the plan. Server rejects version <= current.

schema.description: Schema identifier (timestamp). Take from x-schema-id in this schema file. Helps debug schema mismatches between server and app.

notes.description: General notes about the plan: goals, periodization, contraindications.

max_hr_bpm.description: User's max heart rate (bpm). Reference value only -- the source of truth for targets is segment.target.min/max in absolute BPM. Useful for the LLM when designing zones.

templates.description: Workout templates. Each is one complete cardio session.

id.description: Unique template ID within the plan, e.g. "week1-3x3".

name.description: Display name shown to the user.

notes.description: Coaching notes for the whole session.

Segment.description: Either a leaf segment (warmup/work/recovery/cooldown/steady) with duration+target, or an interval_block that repeats its children N times.

kind.description: Segment kind. Leaf kinds require duration_seconds and target. interval_block requires repeats and children.

duration_seconds.description: Required for leaf kinds. Forbidden for interval_block.

target.description: Required for leaf kinds. Forbidden for interval_block.

repeats.description: Required for interval_block. Forbidden for leaf kinds.

children.description: Required for interval_block. Forbidden for leaf kinds. Children must be leaf segments only (no nested interval_blocks).

Target.description: Intensity target for a leaf segment.

type.description: hr_bpm_range = absolute heart-rate range (min/max in bpm). rpe = perceived exertion 1-10 (min/max as integers). free = no target, just keep moving.

min.description: Lower bound. Required for hr_bpm_range and rpe.

max.description: Upper bound. Required for hr_bpm_range and rpe.

zone_label.description: Optional human label, e.g. "Z2" or "Z3-Z4". Shown to user verbatim.

Progression.description: Hints for how the next plan version should evolve. Optional. The app may show advance_when as text and (in the future) use axis+step to suggest the next version.

step.description: How much to add when advancing. All fields optional.

intervals_delta.description: Add this many repeats to the main interval_block.

work_duration_seconds.description: Add this many seconds to each "work" leaf.

hr_bpm_delta.description: Add this many bpm to target.min/max in "work" leaves.

advance_when.description: Free-form criterion shown to the user, e.g. "after 2 sessions with all intervals in target HR".
